scripts.version: pnpm changeset version && pnpm run -r postVersion
scripts.publish: pnpm --dir packages/js-sdk build && pnpm run -r postPublish && pnpm changeset publish
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/js-sdk build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
scripts.pnpm-install-hack: cd packages/js-sdk && sed -i '' 's/"version": ".*"/"version": "9.9.9"/g' package.json && cd ../.. && pnpm i && git checkout -- packages/js-sdk/package.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/js-sdk build && pnpm --if-present --recursive run typecheck
